name: EngageDock AI – Smart Support Assistant
author: finderpress

sections.description:
EngageDock AI is a customizable floating contact widget for WordPress websites that want more leads and faster visitor communication.
It helps small businesses turn website traffic into calls, texts, emails, and callback requests from one clean contact panel.

Key Features:

  • Click-to-Call – One tap calling on mobile devices
  • Click-to-Text – Direct SMS messaging
  • Email – Quick email link
  • Callback Request Form – Built-in form with email notifications
  • Business Hours Display – Show open/closed status in real-time
  • Social Proof Notifications – “X people contacted us recently” style popups
  • Save Contact (vCard) – Let visitors download your contact info
  • Get Directions – Link to Google Maps
  • Bottom Contact Bar – Always-visible contact bar
  • Analytics Dashboard – Track widget interactions and engagement
  • Fully Customizable – Colors, position, text, and more
  • Mobile Responsive – Looks great on all devices
  • Multisite Compatible – Perfect for managing multiple sites

Why People Install EngageDock AI

  • Launch a professional floating contact widget in minutes.
  • Increase call and callback leads from high-intent visitors.
  • Show real-time open/closed business hours to set clear expectations.
  • Let mobile visitors contact you in one tap.
  • Keep contact actions visible with a bottom contact bar.

External Services

This plugin can connect to external services in the following cases:

  • QR Code API (api.qrserver.com) – Used to render QR codes for phone, text, and email actions inside the widget.

    • Trigger: only when a visitor opens a contact card that requires a QR code.
    • Data sent: encoded destination data for the QR code (such as a tel:, sms:, or mailto: value).
    • Service URL: https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/
    • Provider: goQR / Foundata GmbH
    • Terms of service: https://goqr.me/legal/tos-api.html
    • Privacy policy: https://goqr.me/privacy-safety-security/

  • Google Maps – Used when a visitor clicks a directions or map action that opens Google Maps.

    • Trigger: user click action.
    • Data sent: the destination address text included in the opened Google Maps URL.
    • Service URL: https://www.google.com/maps/
    • Provider: Google
    • Terms of service: https://maps.google.com/help/terms_maps/
    • Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  • Apple Maps – Used on supported devices when a visitor clicks a directions action that opens Apple Maps.

    • Trigger: user click action.
    • Data sent: the destination address text included in the opened Apple Maps URL.
    • Service URL: https://maps.apple.com/
    • Provider: Apple
    • Terms of service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/maps/terms-en.html
    • Privacy policy: https://www.apple.com/privacy/

  • Custom outbound webhook (optional Pro feature) – Sends lead data to the webhook endpoint configured by the site owner.

    • Trigger: when a supported lead form submission is sent and the webhook integration is enabled.
    • Data sent: event name, timestamp, site name, site URL, and the submitted lead payload.
    • Service URL: site-owner defined.
    • Provider terms/privacy: depend on the webhook service selected by the site owner.

Best Use Cases

  • Local services (plumber, electrician, cleaning, repair)
  • Clinics and healthcare practices
  • Agencies and consultants
  • Hotels and hospitality websites
  • Schools and training centers
  • Any business that needs quick website contact options
sections.installation:
For WordPress.org install:

  1. In WordPress Admin, go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for EngageDock AI - Smart Support Assistant
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Go to EngageDock AI > Basic Setup and complete widget setup

For manual ZIP delivery (Free + Pro):

  1. In WordPress Admin, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  2. Upload engagedock-ai-smart-support-assistant.zip (Free) and activate it
  3. If you purchased Pro, upload engagedock-ai-smart-support-assistant-pro.zip
  4. Activate Pro and open EngageDock AI > Plan & License to activate your license key
sections.faq:
Can I use different settings for each site in a multisite network?

Yes! Each site in a WordPress multisite network can have its own settings configured independently.

Does the callback form send emails?

Yes, callback requests are sent via email to the address you specify in the settings. The plugin uses WordPress’s built-in wp_mail() function.

Can I track how many people use the widget?

Yes! EngageDock AI includes a built-in analytics dashboard that tracks widget opens, call clicks, text clicks, email clicks, direction clicks, callback submissions, and more. View your stats at EngageDock AI > Analytics.

Is this plugin good for lead generation?

Yes. The floating contact widget is designed to reduce friction so visitors can call, text, email, or request a callback quickly, which helps improve lead conversion.

Does this work on mobile?

Yes. EngageDock AI is mobile responsive and supports one-tap call/text actions on compatible devices.

How do I customize the colors?

Go to EngageDock AI > Appearance. You can set primary color, secondary color, and text color using the color pickers.

Can I hide the widget on certain pages?

Yes, enter comma-separated page slugs in EngageDock AI > Integrations & Advanced > Excluded Pages.
